senses.gloss:
Bhṛṅga
son of Viśvāvarta, brother of Maṅkha. q. by Maṅkha in his Śrīkaṇṭhacarita 3, 53.

Bhṛṅgadūta
OSM. II. 4061. IV. 3297 (with Oriya metrical transl.). Utkal Uni. 2956.
-by Gaṅgānanda Kavīndra, a Maithila Brāhmaṇa. Darbhanga Raj 1550 (inc.). Rep. Hpr. 1895-1900, p. 19.
-by Paramānanda. Kuru. Uni. I. 736-37.
See S. P. Chaturvedi, ‘A new Khaṇḍakāvya’, AIOC. VI. 630-32. J. of Nagpur Uni.. Dec. 1937.

Bhṛṅgarāja(śrīśailācārya)
-Śivastotra. in 12 v.. Adyar D. IV. 1198. Extr. ii. p. 195.

Bhṛṅga(ṅgi)rājakalpa
med. or Vandhyākalpa. L. D. Ser. 5. 6609-10. Ramsingh 1078. Ranbir III. p. 820. TD. XX. Sup. 927 (k) (mantraśāstra).

Bhṛṅgasandeśa
Pkt. kāvya. See K. K. Raja, CKSL. p. 237.
Pt.. ed. by A. N. Upadhye, Principal Karmarkar Comm. Vol. p.. 217. 221. Poona, 1948. [Page225a]
-C. in Skt. TCD. 1471-A. Tra. Ad. Rep. 1104. 159 (inc.).

Bhṛṅgasandeśa
MT. 3395 (b). Trippūṇittura I. 292.
Pt.. in Sahṛdaya, XXIV. 57. See M. Krishnamachariar, HCSL. Sn. 323 fn.; also K. K. Raja, CKSL. p. 157.
-by Jīvagosvāmin.
See M. Krishnamachariar, HCSL. Sn. 323 fn.
-by Triveṇī. See M. Krishnamachariar, HCSL. Sn. 379.
-by Vāsudeva. in 192 v.. Deśamaṅgalam 512. MD. 11865. TCD. 1480 (inc.). Tra. Ad. Rep. 1103. 154. Trav. Uni. C-1627 (inc.).
See K. K. Raja, CKSL. p.. 120. 233-36; also K. R. Pisharoti, Vāsudeva's Bhṛṅgasandeśa, p.. 190-98. Siddhabhāratī, Rosary of Indology, D.. Siddheshwar Varma Presentation Volume, Pt. II. Hoshiarpur, 1950; also Kerala Skt. Lit. p. 100; also Jain Sid. Bhas. II. ii. p. 61.
Pt.. TSS. 128. 1937.
-C. Deśamaṅgalam 512.

Bhṛṅgasvāmin
poet. See Skm. v. 380 of Calcutta edn.

Bhṛṅgāmalakatailanirmāṇakrama
med. Mysore N. D. XIII. 42151. Extr. p. 231.

Bhṛṅgāra
Bud.
-Kulalokeśvarasādhana. Bud. Cordier II. p. 197. [Page225b]
-Śrīharukabhaṭṭārakarasādhanopāyikā piṇḍikā. Bud. Cordier II. p. 44.

Bhṛṅgāṣṭaka
or Bhramarāṣṭaka. See Bhramarāṣṭaka below.

Bhṛṅgikathā
kāvya. TD. 23563. 24313.

Bhṛṅgin
-Bhṛṅgīstotra. See below.

Bhṛṅgirājauṣadhakalpa
compiled by Bhāvamiśra.
-Kalpasāgara from. Ranbir III. p.. 798. 820 (inc.).

Bhṛṅgiriṭaprārthanā
from Śrīśailamāhātmya in Śivarahasyakhaṇḍa of Brahmāṇḍapurāṇa. MT. 8164.

Bhṛṅgiriṭistuti
Pt.. in Kannada script. Nandisa Bharativilasa Press, Bangalore, 1918.

Bhṛṅgiriṭistuti
or ºstotra. SB. New D.. V. 19688.
-in 52 v.. hymn to Śiva.
Pt.. under the title Bhṛṅgī. Bangalore, 1921. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28, 1338. 170.
-from Brahmāṇḍapurāṇa. Adyar I. p. 238b. Adyar D. IV. 1179. Extr. IV. ii. p. 188. French Inst. I. 101/2. Trav. Uni. Sup. 16633-B.
See also Bhṛṅgīstava an. Śivastotra.

Bhṛṅgī_(ṛṣi)
-Bhṛṅgīśasamhitā. See below. [Page226a]
